Learn more+Offers in-app purchases.Parental control information. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionTHE GREATEST BATTLE FOR LIFE HAPPENS AT THE MICROSCOPIC LEVEL! Prepare to subvert the rules of the genre. In Survivor Cells, dodging or running won't save you. Survival demands an active defense and a relentless offense. Position yourself strategically, face colossal hordes of viruses and bacteria, and build the ultimate biological barrier combining advanced medicines and cutting-edge nanotechnology! 3 ELECTRIFYING GAME MODES • Life's Journey (Campaign): Evolve over the years as you face dangerous infections and relentless mutant bosses. Unlock new protective cells, potent medicines, and genetic technologies. • Endless Mode: Reach the 100-year mark in the campaign to unlock the ultimate challenge. An endless storm of pathogens where every second of survival is a victory for science! • Pandemic Mode (Weekly Challenges): You have only 3 weekly attempts to master a 15-minute mutant challenge. Mix your best cocktail of medicines, survive the chaos, and collect rare proteins to crush the Global Leaderboard! INNOVATIVE FEATURES • Real-Time Cellular Alchemy: Don't rely solely on the luck of the drops! Use the alchemy system at any time during the match to fuse and transform your upgrades. Adapt and shape your build exactly how you want it to grow stronger against the hordes of viruses and bacteria. • No-Escape Tactical Action: Forget the frantic running of traditional survivor-likes. The focus here is on positioning, space management, and creating devastating defensive and offensive synergies. • Deterministic Match Lengths: Plan your sessions with ease with predictable time cycles, perfect for quick and intense gameplay bursts. • Survival Checkpoints: Reach the end of a life cycle and secure a safe checkpoint to catch your breath and rethink your strategy—a true rarity in the genre! • Deep Meta-Progression: Spend your collected resources between matches in the DNA Shop to permanently upgrade your stats and unlock over 7 unique cells with exclusive tactical abilities. The organism is under attack. Do you have what it takes to save the mother cell and achieve longevity? Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionCleaning? Did you say boring? No way! Cleaning Simulator invites you to grab your mop, vacuum cleaner, and sponge for a delightful cleaning adventure. Dirty floors, mountains of dishes, buzzing flies, dusty carpets, and chaotic rooms… They’re all waiting for you. But don’t worry—if you’ve got the right tools in hand, this mess will be sparkling clean in no time. Whether you play just to unwind or aim to complete every task and earn the title of Cleaning Master, the game lets you play your own way. Mop the floors, scrub surfaces with the sponge, load the dishwasher, take out the trash, spray the flies, vacuum the carpets, organize scattered items, and blast away stubborn grime with a pressure washer! Watching the environment transform as you clean is truly satisfying. And with HDR and ray tracing enabled, the way light gleams off those spotless surfaces… It actually makes you want to clean. What Can You Do? Mop the Floors: Use the mop to clean up stains and spills. Scrub with the Sponge: Scrub walls, tables, and countertops thoroughly. Use the Dishwasher: Load dirty dishes, then put them away once they’re clean. Spray the Flies: Eliminate flies and keep things hygienic. Collect Trash: Pick up garbage and throw it away. Organize and Arrange Items: Tidy up scattered boxes and furniture. Use the Pressure Washer: Blast away stubborn dirt with high-pressure water. Use the Vacuum Cleaner: Vacuum the carpets and freshen up the floors. Why Should You Play? Because every cleaning job ends with that satisfying “nailed it” feeling. Because with Ray Tracing and HDR, a freshly cleaned room looks stunning. Because cleaning can be more relaxing than you'd expect. Because sometimes, just ticking tasks off the list feels really good. Whether it’s a messy student apartment, a cluttered warehouse, or a fly-infested kitchen… Every space will transform with your touch. If you’re ready, grab your sponge. The vacuum’s running—let the cleaning begin!
